items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Henry Regis wrote Blue and the Blues.

ctx.x: Uh, you remember, um, fidgety feet? Yeah. That's a nice sensation.

The only, the only, the only, the only thing that, that to my mind, that was original with them, was Kleinert Marmalade. Uh-huh. Larry Shields wrote that. Larry Shields. And Henry Regis wrote Blue and the Blues. Oh, yeah. That to me, that's, it was the only originals that they'd made. Yeah. Everything else was, they had, climb off my nose and this, that, and they had names like that on, see? Yeah. Kick the bucket and, oh, names like that to give them. Yeah.
Climb off my nose. Yeah. Do you remember many other blues that you ever played, just like, say, the Blues in B-flat or anything like that, just without any title? Did you do much? No.
